title: Long-Tenure Resident Multiplier on Home Purchase Financing Late Charges
content:
**Resident tenure note — Home Purchase Financing late charges**

Where the borrower moved in on the home's site 120 or more whole months before the assessment date, as the site lease shows, the residence tenure multiplier is 0.85; where 60 to 119 whole months before, the residence tenure multiplier is 0.95. Where the move-in was fewer than 60 whole months before, no tenure multiplier applies.

The move-in date is the one on the borrower's Home-Site Lease for the financed home's site. The multiplier acts on the late charge figure before its single rounding to the cent, ahead of the program's floor and cap.

| Whole months from the Home-Site Lease move-in date to the assessment date | Residence tenure multiplier |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 0.85 |
| 60 to 119 | 0.95 |
| fewer than 60 | none applies |

*Hypothetical cases (assessment date 2026-03-20).* A move-in on 2016-03-01 is 120 whole months before — 0.85. A move-in on 2016-04-01 is 119 — 0.95. A move-in on 2021-04-01 is 59 — none.
